headings: What's the difference between W4 Pro & X1？
paras: Our W4 Pro AI Interpreter Earbuds feature three translation modes: One-on-One, Listen & Play, Voice Call Translation and Media Translation.
One-on-One: Suitable for bilingual communication between two individuals, providing real-time translation functionality without requiring hands-on operation.

Listen & Play: Ideal for personal participation in the meetings or ; you can record others' speech on your phone and have the earphones play the translations. It can also switch to a speaking mode where the earphones record your speech for translation, then play the results for others to hear.
Voice Call Translation: Designed for multilingual phone calls, providing real-time translation so both participants can communicate naturally over the call.
Media Translation: Designed for translating audio from multimedia on your phone, including videos, online meetings, voice messages, podcasts, and other media content.
X1 AI Interpreter Hub offers a broader range of functionalities, including One-on-One, Listen & Play, Ask & Go, Voice Call, and Multi-Person capabilities.
Ask & Go: This function serves for small chats with the device held in hand. Hold the button to speak and release to play the audio for a translation.
Voice Call Feature: X1 allows for real-time voice calls, enabling communication and translation between individuals in different locations. (*This feature requires the use of two devices.)

Multi-Person Communication:With X1 Meeting, a single device can host meetings for up to 50 participants. Attendees simply join via a QR code or link to view, listen to, or speak through real-time translation on their own devices. Alternatively, you can open the file directly with a plain text editor such as Notepad (Windows) or TextEdit (Mac) – they typically handle UTF‑8 automatically.

You will need to install a third‑party MTP (Media Transfer Protocol) client on your Mac.
